    • initialize

      void initialize() throws LobbyFullException
      Initializes the game with the GameConfig that have been previously set. If no custom GameConfig is set, the default one is used. Notifies every view on the lobby.
      Throws:
      LobbyFullException

      void addPlayer(String playerName) throws LobbyFullException, InvalidParameterException
      Adds a player to the lobby.

      InvalidParameterException - if the username is not valid.
